summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Tradr 2X Short IREN Daily ETF (IREZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides inverse (-2x) exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of IREN Limited (NASDAQ: IREN) stock. IREN develops and operates renewable energypowered data centers, primarily supporting bitcoin mining and high-performance computing workloads. IREZ was launched on Jan 21, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
